(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing specifies I.Z.B.P. plating without any allowance for coating thickness on this bore. Plating buildup will shrink the hole below its H7 limits and prevent the mating shaft from fitting; the designer must add a note to mask the bore before plating or adjust the pre-plate size to account for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a masking callout for the ⌀16 H7 bore during plating, or specify a pre-plate undersize that leaves the finished hole within H7 after coating."}]}
